$comment: Daily Hunt meta (GDD §12, §15; Tech §12). Outside the sim bundle and contentHash like notaboek.json: editing it never changes a hunt or a daily seed. epoch = the UTC day of Daily #1 (placeholder until the launch date is fixed). biomeRotation: day n plays rotation[n mod length], the same biome on every client; a client that can't draw it plays the modes.json daily biome (D-025). grid: the share card's emoji squares = the hunt cut into `segments` equal parts, each coloured by its accuracy (shots that bagged / shots fired). Streak milestones give cosmetics only.
